property_summary: In the reference C, any second successful 10-ether call within the same block.timestamp reverts because block.timestamp is no longer strictly greater than pastBlockTime; the mutant removed that guard so the second same-timestamp call succeeds, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Delete the timestamp guard `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);` so multiple calls in the same block/timestamp succeed and update `pastBlockTime` differently.
